enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe regularly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Turn to right side. Move legs. Sigh. Open eyes briefly. Close eyes. Remain asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, using the toilet, washing face and taking a shower
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Wash hands. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body with towel. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, milk, bread. Close refrigerator. Place bread in toaster. Turn on toaster. Place frying pan on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Crack eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off induction cooker. Transfer eggs to plate. Fill kettle with water. Plug in kettle. Turn on kettle. Pour boiling water into cup. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink tea.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed, packing work bag and checking phone for the day's schedule
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out clothes. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open drawer. Take out underwear. Put on underwear. Walk to desk. Pick up work bag. Open work bag. Put laptop and charger in bag. Close work bag. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Check schedule. Lock phone. Put phone in pocket.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Scroll through news. Put phone away. Listen to music. Arrive at stop. Stand up. Walk to door. Exit bus. Walk to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office, coordinating community programs, answering emails and attending planning meetings
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at office. Greet colleagues. Walk to desk. Sit down. Turn on computer. Log in. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Check meetings. Walk to meeting room. Attend planning meeting. Take notes. Discuss program. Walk back to desk. Answer phone. Make phone calls. Update program schedule. Save changes.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating lunch near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to lunch place. Enter restaurant. Order food. Pay cashier. Receive food. Find empty table. Sit down. Unwrap food. Eat lunch. Drink water. Wipe mouth with napkin. Throw trash in bin. Stand up. Walk out of restaurant. Walk back to office. Enter office. Walk to desk. Sit down.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office, meeting partner organizations and updating program schedules on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Return to desk. Open computer. Open scheduling software. Update program dates. Save changes. Make phone calls. Meet with partner. Discuss collaboration. Take notes. Walk to meeting room. Attend meeting. Present updates. Answer questions. Walk back to desk. Send emails. Update calendar. Close computer. Prepare to leave.

Leave office. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Browse social media. Put phone away. Look out window. Arrive at stop. Stand up. Walk to door. Exit bus. Walk home. Enter home.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner with the induction cooker and eating dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Place pan on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off induction cooker. Transfer food to plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Clear table.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up after dinner, washing dishes and wiping the counter
enriched_activities.desc: Clear table. Scrape plates into trash. Stack dishes. Fill sink with water. Add soap. Wash dishes. Rinse dishes. Place in drying rack. Drain sink. Wipe counter with cloth. Rinse cloth. Hang cloth. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa, watching TV and browsing on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on light. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV and change channels. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open social media. Scroll through feed. Put phone down. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put phone down. Watch TV. Stand up. Turn off TV. Turn off light. Walk to bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up, brushing teeth and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply cleanser. Rub face. Rinse face. Dry face with towel. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Rinse toothbrush. Put toothbrush back. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading in bed with the desk lamp on and falling asleep
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Turn page. Read. Turn page. Close book. Put book on nightstand. Turn off desk lamp. Lie down. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Fall asleep.
